So this is a pretty simple problem. We just need to keep track of our last offer and the sellers last offer. If the difference between the two is greater than some threshold, we just decide to walk. (Note that we can walk in the first round, so we should just have some initial threshold value to start the search). Otherwise, if we are in a "good" range, we offer an amount that is 1 less than the sellers last offer. We keep track of the max we are willing to pay, and only make offers up to that.
